attributes.name: ypy-history
attributes.description: Set to `false` anywhere on the page to keep the page out of the history cache: it is not saved when the user leaves it.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:before:save
events.description: Fires on `document` before the current page is saved to `sessionStorage`. `head` may be changed. Cancel it to skip saving this page.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:after:save
events.description: Fires on `document` after a page was saved to the cache.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:before:restore
events.description: Fires on `document` before cached content is swapped back. A listener may set `ready` to a promise that the extension awaits before the swap.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:after:restore
events.description: Fires on `document` after cached content was restored and the scroll position was set.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:hit
events.description: Fires on `document` when back or forward finds the page in the cache. Cancel it to ignore the cache and request the page. `item` may be replaced.

events.name: ypy:history:cache:miss
events.description: Fires on `document` when back or forward finds no cached page. A listener may set `refreshOnMiss` to reload the page.

config.name: historyCache
config.description: Options of the history cache extension.

config.name: historyCache.size
config.description: How many pages are kept in `sessionStorage`; the oldest is dropped first. `0` turns saving off.

config.name: historyCache.refreshOnMiss
config.description: Reload the page on back or forward when it is not in the cache.

config.name: historyCache.disable
config.description: Turn the cache off without unloading the extension.

config.name: historyCache.swapStyle
config.description: Swap style used to put the cached content back.

config.name: historyCache.encrypt
config.description: Seal the pages kept in `sessionStorage` with WebCrypto (AES-GCM, a key made for the session). `true` keeps the key in `sessionStorage`, so the pages survive a reload; `"memory"` keeps it in memory only, so after a reload the old pages are not readable. Without WebCrypto nothing is stored. `ypy.history.clear()` replaces the key.
